title: Stepper Motor Step Sequence
description: Click through the four-coil energizing cycle and watch the rotation total climb 1.8 degrees at a time.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

educational.audience: Students and mentors working with motors

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a four-coil stepper motor, the learner sequences the coil-energizing pattern that advances the rotor by one step at a time.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-advance cycle with a running rotation total in the panel
pedagogical.assessment: Ask how many steps make one full rotation, and why no sensor is needed to know the angle.
